# package bacnet

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-bacnet"
```

Package bacnet provides transport-neutral BACnet leaf types and helpers.

This package holds addresses, object/property identifiers, application values, decode limits and error sentinels. It does not open sockets and does not import BVLC, NPDU, APDU, service or client packages.

Wire codecs live in sibling packages (bvlc, npdu, apdu, service). BACnet/IP endpoints and the UDP transport live in package bip.

The module is a BACnet/IP (IPv4) client and server developed against ANSI/ASHRAE 135-2024 (Protocol Revision 31 baseline):

  - package client is a supervisory client; it adapts to known remote capabilities and does not require Revision 31 features from remote devices;
  - package server serves a device of your own, with the object model in package server/object and an optional BBMD in package bbmd.

Out of scope: MS/TP, BACnet/IPv6, BACnet/SC, routing between networks, multi-BBMD failover in the client, BTL certification.

Status: the client is tested against pinned open-source peers in containers, the server against the go-bacnet client and the bacnet-stack command-line tools; no physical devices yet. See docs/CLIENT\_SUPPORT.md, docs/SERVER\_SUPPORT.md and INTEROP.md.

AppendTag appends a deterministic encoding of el to dst.

A context element whose Value is a typed primitive (for example Element{Context: true, TagNumber: 1, Value: RealValue(1)}) is encoded as a context-tagged primitive carrying that value's content octets; a context BOOLEAN is one octet. ### func DecodeBACnetError

```go
func DecodeBACnetError(elements []Element) (class, code uint16, err error)
```

DecodeBACnetError parses a BACnet-Error structure.

Two encodings appear on the wire:

 1. Application ENUMERATED class then ENUMERATED code — the standard form, sent by every peer stack and by this library's encoder;
 2. Context \[0] class / \[1] code (unsigned or enumerated content) — a non-standard form this library emitted up to v0.3.0, still accepted.

### func DecodePropertyValue

```go
func DecodePropertyValue(objectType ObjectType, property PropertyIdentifier, value ApplicationValue) (any, bool, error)
```

DecodePropertyValue optionally maps a known object/property combination to a typed value. Unknown combinations return ok=false with no error so callers keep the raw ApplicationValue.

### func EncodeBACnetError

```go
func EncodeBACnetError(dst []byte, class, code uint16) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodeBACnetError encodes the BACnet Error production,

	Error ::= SEQUENCE { error-class ENUMERATED, error-code ENUMERATED }

as two application-tagged ENUMERATEDs (class 2, code 32 → 91 02 91 20). Releases up to v0.3.0 emitted context tags \[0] and \[1] instead, which no other stack produces; DecodeBACnetError still reads that form.

### type CharacterString

```go
type CharacterString struct {
	Encoding uint8
	Value    string
}
```

CharacterString holds a BACnet character string with encoding byte.

Value holds the raw string octets exactly as they appear on the wire after the encoding octet; it is only valid Go text when Encoding is CharacterEncodingUTF8. Use Text to obtain a Go string for the other supported encodings.

#### func ContextCharacterString

```go
func ContextCharacterString(el Element) (CharacterString, error)
```

ContextCharacterString extracts a character string from a context primitive.

#### func (CharacterString) Text

```go
func (c CharacterString) Text() (string, error)
```

Text converts the string octets to a Go (UTF-8) string.

UTF-8 (0) is validated, UCS-4 (3) and UCS-2 (4) are decoded as big-endian code units, and ISO 8859-1 (5) is mapped octet by octet. DBCS (1), JIS X 0208 (2) and unknown encodings return an error wrapping ErrUnsupported; octets that are not valid for the declared encoding return an error wrapping ErrMalformed.

### type HostNPort

```go
type HostNPort struct {
	IP   [4]byte
	Name string // non-empty means name is present and IP is ignored
	None bool   // host is the "none" alternative; IP and Name are ignored
	Port uint16
}
```

HostNPort is BACnetHostNPort:

	host [0] BACnetHostAddress CHOICE {
	  none       [0] NULL,
	  ip-address [1] OCTET STRING,
	  name       [2] CharacterString }
	port [1] Unsigned16

A non-empty Name selects the name alternative, None selects none, and otherwise the IPv4 address in IP is encoded as ip-address.

#### func DecodeHostNPort

```go
func DecodeHostNPort(v ApplicationValue) (HostNPort, error)
```

DecodeHostNPort decodes a BACnetHostNPort from wire elements or from a value built by EncodeHostNPort. Only 4-octet (IPv4) ip-address values are supported; other lengths return an error wrapping ErrUnsupported.
